title: Robotic Surgery Is No Longer Rare At 15.1%
hook: Robotic surgery escaped the niche and nearly doubled in four years.
closing: Robotic surgery is becoming routine, changing what patients encounter in operating rooms.
question: Would you trust robotic surgery?

segments.say: Robotic procedures rose 98%, turning a specialized tool into a mainstream surgical option.
Robots handled 15.1% of general surgeries, proving the technology was no longer rare.
Robotic-surgery revenue reached $7.1 billion, reflecting how quickly hospitals invested in the technology.
